setup.title: Initial setup
setup.tokenIntro: Enter the one-time setup token. The server prints it to its console (standard error) at startup, or writes it to the configured token file.
setup.tokenInvalid: The setup token is wrong. Copy it again from the server console; it changes every time the server starts.

fields.imageWriteBack: Save images next to the media
fields.privacyAcknowledged: I understand that clients learn this server's address

setup.adminCreatedNote: The administrator was already created. Enter the same name to continue; reset the password with jelee-cli if needed.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 bytes with at least 4 different characters, not containing the name.
setup.databaseIntro: The server checks the PostgreSQL version and that all migrations are applied.
setup.mediaIntro: Add the folders the server should scan. They must exist and be readable by the service account. You can also add libraries later.
setup.tmdbIntro: The TMDB key is never entered here; set TMDB_API_KEY_FILE on the server first.
setup.toolchainIntro: The server checks its bundled media probe. Without it, media details stay incomplete.
setup.privacyNotice: Anyone who connects learns the address of this server. Read the network privacy guide before publishing it.
setup.completeIntro: Everything is ready. Finishing creates the libraries and opens the server for sign-in.
setup.stepOrder: This step changed in another window. Reload the page and continue.
setup.finished: Setup is complete. You can now sign in with the administrator account.

issues.localeUnsupported: Choose one of the supported languages.
issues.adminVisibleNameInvalid: The display name is too long or contains control characters.
issues.adminAlreadyCreated: A different administrator name was entered before. Use the same name.
issues.adminExists: An administrator already exists. Use that account instead.
issues.passwordEncodingInvalid: The password must be valid text.
issues.passwordLengthInvalid: The password must be between 12 and 1024 bytes.
issues.passwordTooSimple: The password is too simple. Use more different characters.
issues.passwordContainsName: The password must not contain the account name.
issues.databaseServerOutdated: The PostgreSQL server is too old. Version 16 or later is required.
issues.databaseMigrationDirty: A migration was interrupted. Repair the database with jelee-migrate first.
issues.databaseSchemaOutdated: Database migrations are missing. Run jelee-migrate up first.
issues.mediaNameDuplicate: Two libraries have the same name.
issues.mediaPathNotAbsolute: Enter an absolute folder path without . or .. segments.
issues.mediaPathDuplicate: Two libraries use the same folder.
issues.mediaPathNested: One library folder is inside another.
issues.mediaDirectoryMissing: The folder does not exist or the service account cannot reach it.
issues.mediaDirectoryNotDirectory: The path is not a folder.
issues.mediaDirectoryUnreadable: The service account cannot read this folder.
issues.tmdbCredentialMissing: No TMDB key is configured on the server.
issues.toolchainMissing: The media probe is unavailable. Fix it or continue without it.
issues.nfoReadModeInvalid: Choose a valid NFO read mode.
issues.nfoWriteModeInvalid: Choose a valid NFO write mode.
issues.nfoWriteRequiresRead: Writing NFO files requires reading them.
issues.listenInvalid: Enter an IP address and port, for example 127.0.0.1:8097.
issues.listenNotLoopback: This computer only needs a loopback address such as 127.0.0.1.
issues.listenLoopbackOnly: The local network mode needs a non-loopback address.
issues.allowedHostInvalid: A host name is invalid or repeated.
issues.trustedProxyInvalid: A trusted proxy network is not valid CIDR.
issues.trustedProxiesRequired: Reverse proxy mode needs at least one trusted proxy network.
issues.privacyAcknowledgementRequired: Confirm the privacy notice to publish beyond this computer.
